entities.summary: Qamar-ol-Moluk Vaziri (Persian: قمرالملوک وزیرى ;, born Qamar Khanum Seyed Hosayn Khan, commonly known as "Qamar", was a celebrated Iranian singer, who was also the first woman of her time to sing in public in Iran without wearing a veil. She is known as "the Queen of Persian music".
